about_the_game:
The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.

Features

  • Map Editor and Steam Workshop: Create your own maps and share them with the world on Steam Workshop, and download the ones you like made by the community!

  • Full controller support: Tower Tactics 2 was designed with controller and Steam Deck support in mind!

  • New mechanics: Hero cards, powerful temporary effects, card items, new status effects like Burn, Poison and Frail, new combat types, new enemy abilities and much more! 

  • Enhanced metaprogression: Collect dozens of decks and improve them between runs in multiple new ways!

  • Tons of new content: New cards, enemies, tiles, decks, game modes, maps, trinkets...

  • New challenges await: Will you be able to succeed in the new Sector 4? Sounds challenging, but you will have new tools at your disposal!

More information will be revealed as development continues. Be sure to wishlist the game now to not miss it!
